adjudication.rationale: Verified in diff: `removeMember` calls `self.findMembers()` without changing `offset` (group.js `removeMember`), and `findMembers` computes the request offset using the pre-fetch `user_count` (`Math.min(this.get("user_count"), ...)`). If you’re on the last page (e.g., `user_count=51`, `limit=50`, `offset=50`) and remove the only remaining member, the next `findMembers` call still requests `offset=50`. Server now has `total=50` (GroupsController#members uses `group.users.count`), so `limit(50).offset(50)` returns zero members and meta comes back with `total=50, offset=50`, leaving the UI on an empty `2/2` page. The diff does not include any logic to clamp `offset` to `total - limit` after deletions.
